detailed_description:
The target video is in a warm, cozy lifestyle-film style with soft autumn light, honey-toned color grading, shallow depth of field, and a clean unhurried composition.
[Shot 1] A medium shot opens on <Subject 1> seated at the wooden table by the large window of <Subject 2>, golden afternoon light wrapping around her pink cable-knit cardigan worn softly off both shoulders, the strap of her white slip dress visible at her collarbone. She looks down at her latte and stirs it in slow, small circles with a teaspoon, the foam swirling gently. Outside the glass, golden ginkgo leaves drift past in the breeze; a loose wave of her brown hair slides forward over her shoulder as she leans slightly over the cup.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, she sets the spoon down on its saucer with a soft clink and lifts the ceramic cup with both hands cradled around its warmth. She blows across the surface in one gentle breath, takes a small slow sip, and turns her gaze out the window, watching the leaves drift down the quiet street. She raises her left hand and tucks the fallen strand of hair behind her ear in a single unhurried motion, her cardigan slipping a touch lower on her shoulder, the café's warm lamp glow mixing with the daylight on her profile.
[Shot 3] At 00:04.000, the camera has eased into a tight facial close-up. As if sensing someone watching, she turns her head from the window toward the lens - toward <Subject 3> - and her expression softens into a warm, gentle smile of recognition. The cup rim rests lightly against her lower lip, steam curling up past her cheek, golden light catching the waves of her brown hair. She holds the soft smile and the eye contact into the final frame as a last leaf glides down the window behind her.

overall_soundscape:
A quiet cozy café ambience: soft background chatter and a distant espresso machine hiss, the gentle clink of the spoon on the saucer, the faint sound of her slow sip, and muffled street breeze outside the window glass.

non_diegetic_music:
A mellow acoustic piece at a relaxed tempo, led by warm nylon-string guitar and a light brushed-drum shuffle, with a soft piano figure entering as she turns to smile, resolving gently in the final frame.
